[SWS_CM_10311] Destination of a SOME/IP response message
⌈
The SOME/IP
response message shall use the unicast source IP address and the source port of
the corresponding received SOME/IP request message (see [SWS_CM_10299]) as destination address and destination port for the transmission.
⌋
